summary: Vulnerable items reach ServiceNow again, and one oversized value no longer holds back the rest.

fixes.title: Vulnerable items reach your own ServiceNow tables
fixes.text: Your own ServiceNow tables now receive vulnerable items, whatever their name.

fixes.title: One long value no longer blocks everything
fixes.text: A value too long for its ServiceNow column now holds only its own row. The other rows are sent, and the held rows go once the column is wider.

fixes.title: Long identifiers fit ServiceNow
fixes.text: A long vulnerable item identifier is shortened the way ServiceNow expects, so it fits the column.
